THEATRE REVIEWS UNIDENTIFIED HUMAN REMAINS AND THE TRUE NATURE OF LOVE

Monday, January 29, 1990

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Written by Brad Fraser Directed by Jim Millan Starring Brent Carver and Lenore Zann Crow's Remains glows with confidence BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail Crow's is flying. Correction: Crows are flying. That doesn't look right either. Anyway, the theatre group known as Crow's and based at Toronto's Poor Alex swoops brilliantly into the nineties with Unidentified Human Remains and the True Nature of Love. As titles go, that's a beakful.
